name: card-spotlight
title: Card Spotlight
description: A rounded black information card whose surface lights up on hover. A soft radial light follows the pointer while a fine canvas of blue and purple dots spreads across the face.
use: A feature or information card should feel interactive when explored with the pointer.
avoid: The particle canvas only appears on hover, so touch users see a plain card, and it forces a black surface.
a11y: The spotlight and particle field are hover-only, so keyboard and touch users never see them, and there is no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded near-black card with a thin grey border, holding a bold white heading, a grey paragraph and three bullet lines marked by small indigo dots. On hover a field of tiny violet and blue speckles covers the surface.
behaves: Moving the pointer lights the card with a soft spotlight that follows it, and a fine particle field appears across the face while hovered. Leaving fades the effect back to the plain dark card.
customise: Pass the card content as children and tune the spotlight radius and colour through props. The particle dot colours, size and speed are fixed in the shared effect.
weight: heavy: Mounts a WebGL dot-matrix canvas on hover and tears it down on leave.
